_comment: Override ConnectionStrings:Postgres locally with `dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:Postgres" "..."` from src/DaftechCrm.Api — keeps your real password out of source control.
_comment2: Jwt:SigningKey is required and must be 32+ bytes — generate one with `openssl rand -base64 48` and set it via `dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:SigningKey" "..."`. The app throws on startup if it's missing or too short.
